study: Hitchcock et al. 2011 (NCEE 2011-4001) — Collaborative Strategic Reading (CSR) PD, cluster RCT, grade 5 reading
delivery_evidence: CSR codeveloper provided an initial two-day in-person training, followed by four follow-up coaching sessions (with classroom observations) by coaches throughout the year (Chapter 3, Training segments; p.~34-39).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the GRADE composite reading comprehension score, a published standardized reading assessment not tailored to CSR (Table 4-1, p.44).
curriculum_evidence: CSR is 'a set of instructional strategies designed to improve reading comprehension' that teachers apply while students read their existing social studies texts; no new curriculum/textbook adopted (glossary/Chapter 1; intervention description).
outcome_timing_evidence: Post-test administered in spring at the end of the single school-year implementation; report notes no follow-up wave beyond the one-year posttest (Table 4-1, p.44; extraction notes).
